css: .container { width: 100%; max-width: 1280px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; padding-left: 32px; padding-right: 32px; } .row { display: flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 16px; grid-row-gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .max-560 { max-width: 560px; } .heading-xl { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-weight: 400; color: #141613; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: 104px; line-height: 0.95; } .h-italic { font-style: italic; color: #d4502a; } .eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 12px; font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #141613; } .eyebrow-line { width: 32px; height: 1px; background-color: #d4502a; } .lead { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.6; color: #4a4d47; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; } .kanji-vertical { font-family: "Noto Serif JP", serif; font-size: 120px; line-height: 1; color: #d4502a; opacity: 0.9; writing-mode: vertical-rl; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .button { text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; grid-column-gap: 12px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #d4502a; background-color: #d4502a; color: #fffdf9; font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, transform 300ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .button:hover { background-color: #141613; border-color: #141613; transform: translateY(-2px); } .button.is-secondary { background-color: transparent; color: #141613; border-color: #141613; } .button.is-secondary:hover { background-color: #141613; color: #f2ede4; } .button-arrow { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; background-color: rgba(255, 253, 249, 0.18); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; } .hero { padding-top: 72px; padding-bottom: 96px; } .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr; grid-column-gap: 72px; align-items: end; } .hero-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 32px; padding-bottom: 24px; } .hero-stats { display: flex; grid-column-gap: 48px; padding-top: 32px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 19, 0.14); } .stat-number { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; color: #141613; } .stat-label { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 6px; color: #6a6c65; } .hero-visual { position: relative; } .hero-image-wrap { border-radius: 999px 999px 28px 28px; overflow: hidden; height: 640px; } .cover-image { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .hero-badge { position: absolute; left: -56px; bottom: 64px; width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 999px; background-color: #141613; color: #f2ede4; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; border: 6px solid #f2ede4; } .hero-badge-top { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: #f08a5d; } .hero-badge-main { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.05; } .hero-kanji { position: absolute; right: -8px; top: 24px; } @media screen and (max-width: 991px) { .heading-xl { font-size: 76px; } .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-row-gap: 56px; } .hero-image-wrap { height: 560px; } .hero-badge { left: 24px; bottom: 24px; } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { .container { padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; } .heading-xl { font-size: 56px; } .lead { font-size: 18px; } .hero { padding-top: 40px; padding-bottom: 64px; } .hero-stats { grid-column-gap: 28px; } .stat-number { font-size: 34px; } .hero-image-wrap { height: 460px; } .hero-kanji { display: none; } } @media screen and (max-width: 479px) { .heading-xl { font-size: 46px; } .hero-stats { flex-wrap: wrap; grid-row-gap: 20px; } }
